subtechniques.description: Open source software might be compiled by themselves to prevent any malware which has been added during compiling to affect the system.

subtechniques.description: Firmware password reset protection is a macOS feature which mitigates the possibility to use hardware hacks to disable or bypass a firmware password.

subtechniques.name: USB with secure firmware
subtechniques.description: USBs with secure firmware (open source) might be used to reduce the attack surface.

subtechniques.name: Hash-based software integrity verification
subtechniques.description: Before installing software, the adversary computes or verifies the cryptographic hash (SHA-256, SHA-512) of downloaded binaries against the publisher's announced value, detecting in-transit tampering, MITM, and supply chain substitution. Lighter-weight complement to GPG signature verification and self-compilation.

procedures.name: GtkHash
procedures.description: GtkHash is a free, open source desktop utility for computing and verifying message digests and checksums (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and more). Used for verifying downloaded software against publisher-provided hashes. https://gtkhash.org/

procedures.name: K-iPhone
procedures.description: Kryptall® K IPHONE is a firmware modified encrypted and secure cell phone that protects your privacy from eavesdropping. It uses certified encryption algorithms and a global network of servers to ensure secure voice and data communications with any phone type. https://www.kryptall.com/index.php/kryptall-mobile-products/kryptall-k-iphone-secure-cellular-communications

procedures.name: Oversight
procedures.description: OverSight keeps an eye on your Mac's mic and webcam, alerting you whenever either is activated. https://objective-see.org/products/oversight.html
